title: A burping frog
done: You made a burping frog! Excuse me, frog. Say pardon.

steps.say: Put a green square flat on the table.
Put another green square next to it. This is the frog.
Put a triangle on top of one square. An eye.
Put a triangle on top of the other square. Two eyes.
Put a small red triangle under the frog. Its tongue. BURP!
